neighbours.label: a single unified source: the noun after 'one'/'single' meaning everything in one place ('one provider', 'one-stop shop', 'a single place')
fire: Our agency gives you one contact handling every detail of the move.
The new dashboard offers a single place to manage all your accounts.
They want to become a one-stop shop for legal and tax services.
With this app you get one hub for messages, calendars and files.
Hiring a general contractor means you have one company for the whole renovation.
The portal is a single destination for permits, licences and fees.
Customers love having one supplier for paint, tiles and timber.
The clinic aims to be a one-stop centre for family health needs.
quiet: Our agency gives you several contacts handling different parts of the move.
The new dashboard offers many pages to manage your various accounts.
They want to grow into a respected firm for legal and tax services.
With this app you can send messages and share files with friends.
Hiring a general contractor means the renovation will be scheduled properly.
The portal lists permits, licences and fees for each district.
Customers buy paint, tiles and timber from different local suppliers.
The clinic aims to improve family health in the neighbourhood.
